required_preprocessing_pipeline: Step 1: Header stripping — Remove transport headers (Received, Return-Path, Message-ID, DKIM, SPF).
Step 2: PII Entity Masking — Apply deterministic regex for email addresses, phone numbers, SSNs, credit card numbers, and crypto addresses.
Step 3: HTML Sanitization — Strip raw markup tags and scripts while extracting anchor text and href targets.
Step 4: Unicode Normalization — Convert zero-width spaces, homoglyphs, and non-standard whitespace to clean ASCII/UTF-8 strings.
Step 5: Privacy Hashing — Maintain one-way SHA-256 hashes of raw inputs for provenance verification without storing unmasked personal records.
